guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice has the largest anomalies: latency-90 rose from 0.0096 to 1.16 (z=+2400), CPU rose about 6x (2.6 to 18.95) and memory about 6.4x, while its callee productcatalogservice stayed flat (CPU z=-1.13, latency-50 z=+1.0) and the frontend latency rise follows it. CPU and memory both rose, so cpu vs mem is not fully separable; CPU is chosen because the latency-driven saturation fits it best, and the logs have no errors and the traces no error spans, so there is no direct confirmation.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or reschedule the recommendationservice pods and raise its CPU limits or scale out replicas, then check whether latency and CPU return to baseline. Review its recent deploys and resource usage to find the cause of the CPU and memory growth.
